card.name: Word before a sentence-ending location or noun
card.fires_on: The last word of a clause just before a full stop, often a preposition or noun like on, in, site, conditions or children. It appears in website notices and warning lines.

modes.label: Website notices
modes.description: Prepositions or nouns ending a clause in web page disclaimers or help text.
modes.example: Note that these files are not on the IDEAS<< site>>. Please be patient as

modes.label: Warning lines
modes.description: Final noun in safety or storage statements, right before the period.
modes.example: Keep this product out of reach of<< children>>. In case of accidental overdose, call

modes.label: Prepositions after a verb phrase
modes.description: A preposition like on or in that begins a place phrase in a notice.
modes.example: Keep zaleplon capsules<< in>> a safe place to prevent misuse and abuse

card.plain: It fires on the word that finishes a stock notice or warning sentence, just before the period.
